label: Dimensional vision and interpretation
title: The dimensional vision: rules, states, and interpretation
summary: A durable account of the user's dimensional-beam vision, the absence of an automatically preferred rule-as-state layout, and the distinct requirements of preservation, faithful representation, restoration, and endogenous organization.
takeaway: Keep law, state family, and interpretation explicit. Compare representations under declared causal and resource constraints, while preserving exact controls and scoped negative findings.
